title: Quick Order
description: Quickly add products to your cart by searching, pasting SKUs, or uploading a file.

search.label: Search for Product
search.hint: Type product name or item number
search.placeholder: Search by product name or item number

textPaste.label: Item number with quantity
textPaste.hint: Enter product codes with optional quantity (default: 1)
textPaste.placeholder:
Paste SKU and quantity pairs, e.g.:
SKU001, 2
SKU002, 5
textPaste.description: Enter product codes separated by comma or new line. Optionally add quantity after each code (default: 1).

fileUpload.title: Select a file
fileUpload.description: Upload a valid CSV or XLSX file to view all products with just one click. You can download a template using the link below.
fileUpload.selectFile: Select a CSV or XLSX file to upload

productList.empty: No products added yet. Use the search, paste, or upload to add products.

overview.title: Order Overview
overview.secureTransmission: Your data is transmitted securely and encrypted.
